podcast.title: Evolution of Musical Style (1975)
podcast.body: In 1975, he articulated that the music Jefferson Airplane created in the 1960s was a "phase" that the band "simply grew out of," explaining their transition to a new musical direction as Jefferson Starship. "When Paul Cantner was asked in 1975 about the musical changes in his band which had formed a decade earlier in San Francisco he said that the music that they made in the 60s was a phase that they simply grew out of."

podcast.title: Death (January 29, 2016)
podcast.body: Paul Kantner died on January 29, 2016, due to multiple organ failure. "January 29th, two members of the Jefferson Airplane, Paul Katner, multiple organ failure..."

podcast.title: Baby Boomer Lifestyle Changes
podcast.body: His experience mirrored that of millions of other baby boomers, where life in his 30s during the 1970s differed significantly from his 20s, especially for those who managed to survive "doing lots of drugs." "But like millions of other baby boomers life look different to Cantner and other band members in their 30s then it did when they were in their 20s especially if they manage to survive a wider no drag races and doing lots of drugs and I'm just talking about Grace Slick."
